summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Trikafta (ELX/TEZ/IVA) NDA. Early in the review the Division stated it did not anticipate an Advisory Committee meeting, and the multidisciplinary review confirms that although a Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee meeting was considered, the Division deemed the clinical trial evidence sufficiently robust that AdComm discussion was unnecessary. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
